apps.localizedDescription:
TASM2 offline patch — The Amazing Spider-Man 2 (iOS 1.3.1):

Gameloft's servers for The Amazing Spider-Man 2 have been dead since ~2018, and the iOS build hangs forever on “Downloading profile”. This patches the game so it launches, plays and saves entirely offline.

Nine instructions, all in the arm64 slice, every one derived from the disassembly and verified on the binary that actually ships. No new save format, no injected code, no size change.

Confirmed on device (LiveContainer, iOS): a continuous playthrough through the prologue, all of chapter 1 and into chapter 2, with the app force-quit several times along the way. Settings, trophies, exploration, skills, position, tutorial state and the story cursor all survive.

versions.localizedDescription:
The Amazing Spider-Man 2 (1.3.1) — patched to launch, play and save entirely offline, after Gameloft shut down its servers.

Nine instructions in the arm64 slice, all derived from the disassembly and re-verified on the binary in this IPA. No size change, no injected code.

Extra patch flags for this build: --fail-network --kill-spinner (empty means the nine shipped edits and nothing else).

Confirmed on device: a continuous playthrough through the prologue, all of chapter 1 and into chapter 2, with the app force-quit several times. Settings, trophies, exploration, skills, position, tutorial state and the story cursor all survive.

• Signature stripped — re-sign with LiveContainer / SideStore / Sideloadly.
• Install fresh rather than over the top: LiveContainer converts the executable at install time, and replacing a binary inside an installed .app produces cannot dlopen a main executable.
• Built by the Patch TASM2 IPA workflow (run #37).

See the README for what works, what does not, and how each edit was arrived at.
